mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tag (tag_name, tag_type, tag_use_count, created_at) VALUES (#{tagName}, #{tagType}, #{tagUseCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id, tag_name, tag_type, tag_use_count, created_at FROM tag WHERE tag_name = #{tagName} ORDER BY tag_type LIMIT 1
SELECT tag_id, tag_name, tag_type, tag_use_count, created_at FROM tag ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT tag_id, tag_name, tag_type, tag_use_count, created_at FROM tag ORDER BY tag_type, tag_name
SELECT t.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_type, t.tag_use_count, t.created_at FROM tag t INNER JOIN image_tag it ON t.tag_id = it.tag_id WHERE it.image_id = #{imageId} ORDER BY t.tag_type, t.tag_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO image_tag (image_id, tag_id, created_at) VALUES (#{imageId}, #{tagId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image_tag WHERE image_id = #{imageId} AND tag_id = #{tagId}
